data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.5m (2017: favourable development of GBP 14.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 1.9m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.5m in respect of total Reinsurance business. In addition to the favourable development reported above, the Syndicate result has also benefited from the resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator, in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. This has resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 22.744 million, primarily driven by favorable claims development across various underwriting years (2011-2016) as indicated by the claims development triangle. Additionally, the Syndicate's result benefited from a GBP 11.75 million gross release due to the resolution of a dispute concerning historic binding authority agreements, leading to a return of claims paid. The total gross prior year development is a release of GBP 34.494 million.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is derived from the gross claims development triangle (-GBP 22.744m) combined with an additional gross release of GBP 11.75m from a dispute resolution mentioned in the narrative. The narrative text on page 9 also provides a net prior year release figure of GBP 3.5m, which is not used for the primary gross figure.
